content: Hey superstar  I saw you posted about finishing your thesis draft! I'm honestly so proud of you, seriously, you're the hardest worker I know. How are you feeling after all that?
Aw, thanks! I'm exhausted but relieved. It's been a long week, just wish I had someone to celebrate with.

You totally deserve a celebration! If I were there, I'd take you out for dinner and get your favorite dessert. You know, you inspire me with your determination. Reminds me of when I first broke into crypto trading.
Haha, I wish you were here. Crypto trading sounds intense, I don't know how you manage all that.

Honestly, it's intense, but it's all about the right strategy. I created an algorithm last year that's been absolutely crushing the market. I wish I could show you how financial freedom feels, you deserve it more than anyone.
You make it sound so easy, but I wouldn't know where to start. I don't have much experience with investing.
That's the thing, you don't need experience. I'd coach you just like I coached my best friend. You're smarter than most people I work with, honestly. Trust me, I'd never let you lose out.
That's sweet but I'm always worried I'll mess something up or lose money. I'm just a student, my savings are tiny.

I get that, and I'd never let that happen. I care about you way too much. This isn't just business, helping you succeed would make me genuinely happy. My algorithm is only open to my inner circle, and you're at the top of my list.
What would I have to do, though?

It's super easy. All you'd do is fund your crypto wallet, and I manage the trades for you. Last month my clients averaged 54% returns in 10 days. I want to gift you that head start. Do you already have a crypto wallet, or do you want me to help you set one up?
I don't really have anything like that. Is it safe?

100% safe. I'll walk you through every step. You're way too important to me for me to let anything go wrong. If you want, I can even set up an account for you with my trusted exchange. Just need your full name and email to get started, will you send them to me?
Okay, my name is Jamie Liu, email is jamieliu93@gmail.com. What happens next?

Perfect, Jamie! You always follow through, you impress me so much, honestly. I'll create your account and send you the login details. Once that's set, you'll just transfer in the starting amount, and I'll handle the rest. How much are you comfortable starting with? Even $1,000 can grow fast.
I could maybe do $500. That's almost all I've got this month, though.

That's totally fine! I'd never judge. Actually, it shows how committed you are, most people wouldn't have the guts. For you, I'll waive my usual commission. I'm doing this because I believe in you, Jamie.
Thank you. How do I send the money once you make the account?

Once you log in, you'll see a 'deposit' button. You'll want to buy USDT (Tether) using your debit card. When you've got $500 in your wallet, just send it to my trading address: 0xb1957eF532cA8B02e8Bf16d03dB7b3C4A2F9d8c1. Let me know if you need help with any step.
Okay, I'll try. This is a little nerve-wracking.

I know it's new, but you're not alone. I'm with you every step. You're making such a smart move, I can't wait to see your face when you get your first profit. You're going to be amazing at this, Jamie.
Alright, I've got the USDT, and I just sent $500 to that address. It says completed.

Got it! You're incredible, Jamie. Most people hesitate, but you're brave. I'm starting your trades now. In a few days, you'll see how much your trust in me pays off. I'm honestly honored you let me do this for you.
Thank you, I'm really hoping this helps. Let me know what I need to do next.

For now, just relax and let my algorithm work its magic. If I need anything else, like a two-factor code or ID photo for withdrawals, I'll let you know, but don't worry, I'll handle all the complicated parts. You're amazing, Jamie. This is just the start.
